decisions.reason: As a 2019 product line with several models that is close to the core fluid-handling offer, it likely absorbed meaningful development and sales commitment, so management would be inclined to continue it unless there is clear evidence of persistent failure.

Because the hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on the firm's established filtration business in a growing and investment-oriented firm, management is likely to justify and retain it, though with somewhat less commitment than a larger product line.
The gravity band coolant filter also sits near the firm's core modular filtration range, so the firm can plausibly treat any weak uptake as temporary and keep it rather than admit a mistaken launch.
